usual_baseline: A capacity assessment is usually recorded (85–100%), but the detail is weak. The specific decision is named in only 37% [3665]. Functional tests lack evidence in 40–50% [3665]. Best interests are covered in 53% [3584]. In Section 3 patients, admission assessment was 46.2% and three-month review 7.7% [3574].
fix_that_works: A 30-minute teaching session on the MCA template, reinforced at MDT and handover: diagnostic test 77.5% to 95%, functional parts 70% to 90–100%, reasoning 60% to 92.5% [3555].
fix_that_fails: No failed fix reported in these audits
consultant_advice: Only one of five audits closed the loop. Checking that capacity was mentioned adds little; it usually is. Audit the quality of the four functional tests and whether the decision is specific, or three-month Section 3 reassessment, which was almost never done.
